stats.power: How hard your attacks hit once correct answers have charged your weapon.
stats.defense: Cuts the damage you take from each boss hit (about 3% per point, capped at 60%).
stats.focus: How much charge each correct answer gives your weapon, and how fast your dash recovers.
stats.luck: Critical-hit chance: 2% per point, capped at 30%. Never changes coins, drops or prices.

effectTypes.streak_damage: +value% damage per consecutive correct answer (stacks up to 5).
effectTypes.first_strike: The first correct answer of a fight deals +value% damage.
effectTypes.shield_on_correct: Gain a value-HP shield after each correct answer.
effectTypes.second_chance: Once per fight, a wrong answer becomes a miss with no damage taken.
effectTypes.heal_on_streak: Heal value HP after 3 correct answers in a row.
effectTypes.thorns: Reflect value% of damage taken back to the boss.
effectTypes.coin_bonus: +value% coins from quests (all sources combined cap at 25%).
effectTypes.xp_bonus: +value% XP from battles (never lesson XP; all sources combined cap at 25%).
effectTypes.hint: Once per fight, remove value wrong answer(s) from a question.
effectTypes.dodge: value% chance to dodge a boss attack automatically.
effectTypes.low_hp_power: +value% damage while below 30% HP. Reserved: not used in v1 because it rewards fighting on when nearly wiped out, the in-game version of revenge trading.
effectTypes.steady: Your damage can't vary: no crits and no glancing blows. Value is unused (0).
effectTypes.damage_reduction: Take value% less damage from every source.
effectTypes.damage_cap: No single boss hit can take more than value% of your max HP.
effectTypes.buffer_hp: Start each fight with a value-HP buffer bar that soaks damage before your HP. It does not refill during the fight.
effectTypes.telegraph: Boss attack wind-ups become visible value seconds earlier (all sources combined cap at 0.6 seconds).
effectTypes.start_charge: Start each fight with value% of a full weapon charge, rounded to whole pips (33 = 1 of 3 pips).
effectTypes.periodic_double: Every value seconds of a fight, your next charged hit deals double damage. Periods don't add up: with several items, the shortest wins.
effectTypes.mix_bonus: +value to every stat if your 4 armor pieces come from at least 3 different sets.
effectTypes.charge_hold: Your weapon charge never fades while you wait. Value is unused (0). Reserved: not used in v1 because charge never fades in the battle engine, so it would do nothing (Patience Charm uses shield_on_correct instead).
effectTypes.hp_cost: Lose value% of your max HP at the start of each fight (a fee or premium you pay up front). All sources combined cap at 50%; it never counts as damage taken.
effectTypes.damage_dealt_mod: Change all damage you deal by value% (negative values are a tradeoff).
effectTypes.discount_window: For 3 seconds after the boss lands a big attack, your hits deal +value% damage. A big attack hits for at least 80% of the boss's hardest-hitting attack and must actually land (a shield soaking it still counts; a dodge doesn't).
effectTypes.review_queue: After the fight, your trading journal lists up to value questions you missed, with the right answer and why.
effectTypes.damage_over_time: Your hits deal an extra value% of their damage spread over the next 5 seconds.
effectTypes.last_stand: Once per fight, a hit that would knock you out leaves you at value HP instead.
effectTypes.buff_extend: Once per fight, when a timed effect (one with a duration) is about to expire, extend it by value seconds.

effectNotes: Any effect may carry an optional "duration" in seconds; without it the effect lasts the whole fight.
Effects of the same type from different items add together, except once-per-fight effects (second_chance, hint, last_stand, buff_extend), where each item grants its own single use.
Rule for designers: within the same world and slot, no two items share an effect type.

effects.text: Take 10% less damage from every source.

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 20% of your max HP.

effects.text: Critical hits deal +40% damage.

effects.text: Take 30% less damage from every source.
Deal 15% less damage.

effects.text: Your first correct answer of each fight deals +35% damage.

bonuses.text: Payment History: +1 defense, +1 focus.

effects.text: Heal 6 HP after 3 correct answers in a row.

Asterisk Spotted: +4 seconds on hard questions, and once per fight Hoot crosses out a wrong answer.

effects.text: +4 seconds on hard questions.
Once per fight, remove 1 wrong answer from a question.

bonuses.text: Sleep On It: +2 defense, +1 focus.
The Urge Passed: no single boss hit can take more than 18% of your max HP. A spending limit per purchase, not per month.

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 18% of your max HP.

items.name: Penny's Piggy Mallet

effects.text: Critical hits deal +25% damage.

items.unlock: boss drop: boss-w1-inflato (guaranteed on first win)
items.lesson: Saved money beats inflation only when it's put to work earning more than prices rise.
items.flavor: Penny swears no piggy banks were harmed. It is, technically, a piggy bank.

items.name: Bull-Horn Lance

effects.text: Critical hits deal +20% damage.

items.unlock: shop (World 2)
items.lesson: Bull markets reward conviction, but even strong trends end; ride them with a plan for the reversal.
items.flavor: Chip's horns, polished and pointy. He wants them back by Friday.

items.name: Moving-Average Bow

effects.text: Damage can't vary: no crits and no glancing blows. Smooth, a little slow.

items.unlock: shop (World 2, after finishing 'Moving Averages: Smoothing the Noise')
items.lesson: Moving averages smooth out noise but always lag behind the price.
items.flavor: Always a little late. Never flustered.

items.name: Delta Daggers

effects.text: +6% damage per consecutive correct answer (up to 5 stacks). The faster you go, the faster you speed up.

items.unlock: shop (World 3)
items.lesson: Delta measures how much an option moves per $1 move in the stock; gamma measures how fast delta itself changes.
items.flavor: Two blades. Twice the Greek.

items.name: Theta Scythe

effects.text: Hits deal an extra 20% of their damage over the next 5 seconds.

items.unlock: shop (World 3)
items.lesson: Time decay works against option buyers and for option sellers, a little every day.
items.flavor: Tick. Tock. Ouch.

items.name: Tick-Value Trident

effects.text: Your first correct answer each fight deals +25% damage.

items.unlock: shop (World 4)
items.lesson: Every futures contract has a fixed dollar value per tick, so you can know your risk before you enter.
items.flavor: Three prongs: ES, NQ, YM. Micros sold separately. (Kidding. Same shop.)

items.name: Mark-to-Market Maul

effects.text: Critical hits deal +30% damage.

items.unlock: shop (World 4)
items.lesson: Futures accounts settle daily: gains and losses are added or taken in cash at each day's close.
items.flavor: Settles all debts. Daily.

items.name: Piggy-Bank Buckler

effects.text: Take 4% less damage.

items.unlock: shop (World 1)
items.lesson: A savings account is your first shield: boring, safe and always there.
items.flavor: Coin slot doubles as a peephole.

items.name: Ledger Lantern

effects.text: Boss wind-ups show 0.3 seconds earlier.

items.unlock: shop (World 1)
items.lesson: Tracking your spending shows where your money is going before it's gone.
items.flavor: Fueled by receipts. Smells faintly of coffee you didn't need.

items.name: Moat Shield

effects.text: Take 8% less damage.

items.unlock: shop (World 2)
items.lesson: Companies with wide moats can fend off competitors and keep earning high returns for years.
items.flavor: There's a small moat around the rim. A tiny fish lives there. His name is Warren.

items.name: Trading Journal Tome

effects.text: After each fight, your journal lists up to 5 questions you missed, with the right answers.
+10% XP from battles.

items.unlock: shop (World 2, after finishing 'Journal, Backtest, Paper Trade')
items.lesson: Traders who journal every trade learn from their mistakes instead of repeating them.
items.flavor: Page one: 'Note to self: stop doing that.'

items.name: Spread Shield

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 15% of your max HP.
Deal 10% less damage.

items.unlock: shop (World 3)
items.lesson: A vertical spread caps both your maximum loss and your maximum gain.
items.flavor: Two layers, bolted together at the strikes.

items.name: Margin-Buffer Tower Shield

effects.text: Start each fight with a 20-HP margin buffer.

items.unlock: shop (World 4)
items.lesson: Keeping cash well above maintenance margin is what stops a normal dip from becoming a margin call.
items.flavor: Heavy, tall and extremely unexciting. Exactly like good risk management.

items.name: Correlation Charm

effects.text: +2 to every stat if your 4 armor pieces come from at least 3 different sets.

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'Diversification: Many Baskets')
items.lesson: Diversification works best when your holdings don't all move together (low correlation).
items.flavor: Four tiny charms that never agree on anything. Perfect.

items.name: Patience Charm

effects.text: Every correct answer adds a 2-HP shield: small, steady deposits that keep you in the game.

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'Dollar-Cost Averaging and Staying Put')
items.lesson: Time in the market beats timing the market; steady automatic investing keeps you in the game.
items.flavor: Does nothing quickly. On purpose.

items.name: Index Autopilot Amulet

effects.text: Damage can't vary: no crits and no glancing blows. You get the market's return, every time.

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'The Index Fund Income Engine')
items.lesson: An index fund gives you the whole market's return at a tiny cost, instead of betting on picking winners.
items.flavor: Bolt built it. It has exactly one setting.

items.name: Fee-Free Feather

effects.text: +5% coins from quests. Fewer leaks, more kept.

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'Funds, ETFs, and the Fee Leak')
items.lesson: A fund fee of 1% instead of 0.05% can quietly eat a big chunk of your money over decades.
items.flavor: Weighs nothing. Saves plenty.

items.name: Scam Radar Ring

effects.text: Once per fight, a wrong answer becomes a miss. The ring buzzed in time.

items.unlock: quest: q-w1-grizz-gauntlet
items.lesson: Guaranteed high returns, pressure to act now and secrecy are the classic red flags of a scam.
items.flavor: Buzzes whenever someone says 'guaranteed returns'. It buzzes a lot online.

items.name: Lucky Penny

effects.text: Critical hits deal +10% damage. Luck helps a little; it is not a plan.

items.unlock: achievement: streak_7 (Week Warrior)
items.lesson: Luck is real in markets over short periods, but skill and process are what you control.
items.flavor: Penny's cousin. Distant. Very shiny.

items.name: Mr. Market's Mood Ring

effects.text: 5% chance to dodge. You can read the boss's mood.

items.unlock: shop (World 2)
items.lesson: Market prices swing with fear and greed far more than the underlying businesses change.
items.flavor: Currently: euphoric. Check back in five minutes.

items.name: Greeks Monocle

effects.text: Boss wind-ups show 0.3 seconds earlier. You can see the acceleration.

items.unlock: shop (World 3, after finishing 'Vega, Rho & the Full Picture')
items.lesson: The Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega) tell you how an option's price will react to changes.
items.flavor: Hoot wears it ironically. Then unironically.

items.name: Contango Compass

effects.text: Once per fight, roll an expiring timed effect (like a Protective Put policy) forward by 15 seconds.

items.unlock: shop (World 4)
items.lesson: Rolling a futures position to the next contract can cost or earn money depending on the shape of the futures curve.
items.flavor: Always points to next month.

items.name: Grand Champion Crest

effects.text: +10% XP from battles.

items.unlock: achievement: all_units (Grand Champion)
items.lesson: Real financial confidence comes from understanding the whole system, from savings accounts to futures.
items.flavor: Earned, never bought. There's no price tag. Literally.

items.name: Autopay Visor

effects.text: Start each fight with a 5-HP buffer.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: A reminder set a few days before each due date gives you time to move money before a bill is late.
items.flavor: Beeps three days early. Then beeps again. Then beeps until you pay.

items.name: Autopay Breastplate

effects.text: Heal 5 HP after 3 correct answers in a row.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 12 and deeper
items.lesson: Automatic transfers on payday move your savings first, before the money has a chance to get spent.
items.flavor: Gets a little heavier every two weeks. In a good way.

items.name: Autopay Greaves

effects.text: +3 seconds on hard questions.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 6 and deeper
items.lesson: Autopay for the minimum plus a manual extra payment means you are never late and still pay the balance down fast.
items.flavor: The knees click on the first of every month.

items.name: Autopay Boots

effects.text: Heal 3 HP after 3 correct answers in a row.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: Late fees are one of the most avoidable costs in money: automate the payment and they never happen.
items.flavor: They walk to the mailbox by themselves. Slightly unsettling.

items.name: Avalanche Helm

effects.text: Critical hits deal +10% damage.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 2 and deeper
items.lesson: List every debt by its interest rate (APR); the one at the top of that list is costing you the most.
items.flavor: Comes with a tiny avalanche warning sign. It is for the debts, not for you.

items.name: Avalanche Hauberk

effects.text: +4% damage per consecutive correct answer (up to 5 stacks).

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 8 and deeper
items.lesson: When one debt is paid off, roll its whole payment onto the next one, so each payoff comes faster than the last.
items.flavor: Chainmail, but every link is a cancelled balance.

items.name: Avalanche Legguards

effects.text: Critical hits deal +20% damage.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 14 and deeper
items.lesson: Paying off a card that charges 24% APR is like earning a guaranteed 24% return; almost no investment reliably beats that.
items.flavor: Heavy. Ruthless. Always starts at the top.

items.name: Avalanche Crampons

effects.text: Your first correct answer of each fight deals +10% damage.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 2 and deeper
items.lesson: Keep paying at least the minimum on every debt so fees stay away while your extra money attacks the highest rate.
items.flavor: Spiky, grippy, and only climbing one debt at a time.

items.name: Credit Check Circlet

effects.text: Once per fight, remove 1 wrong answer from a question. You spotted the error on your report.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 9 and deeper
items.lesson: You can check your credit reports for free and dispute any mistakes you find on them.
items.flavor: Reads your credit report so you do not have to. You should anyway.

items.name: Credit Builder Vest

effects.text: Start each fight with a 6-HP buffer. Unused credit is breathing room.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 3 and deeper
items.lesson: Keeping your card balance under about 30% of the limit (lower is better) helps your credit score.
items.flavor: Plenty of pockets. Most of them deliberately empty.

items.name: Credit Builder Trousers

effects.text: Gain a 1-HP shield after each correct answer.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: One small purchase paid in full every month builds payment history without ever costing you interest.
items.flavor: Plain, sturdy, paid off.

items.name: Long History Boots

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 20% of your max HP.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 16 and deeper
items.lesson: The age of your credit accounts matters, so keeping your oldest no-fee card open usually helps your score.
items.flavor: Older than you think. Comfier every year.

items.name: Fine Print Spectacles
items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: APR is the yearly cost of borrowing; APY includes compounding and is the number to compare for savings.
items.flavor: Magnifies tiny text up to 400%. Also magnifies your own handwriting, sadly.

items.name: Fine Print Robe

effects.text: +2 seconds on hard questions.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 4 and deeper
items.lesson: A '0% intro APR' ends on a set date; know that date and the rate that comes after it before you sign.
items.flavor: Every thread is a footnote. Every footnote has a footnote.

items.name: Asterisk Leggings

effects.text: 6% chance to dodge a boss attack. You saw the fee coming.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 7 and deeper
items.lesson: A fee table lists every charge an account can make; if a deal hides its fee table, that's your answer.
items.flavor: Covered in tiny stars. None of them are good news.

items.name: Fine Print Loafers

effects.text: +2 seconds on hard questions.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: Free trials often turn into paid plans automatically; set a reminder to cancel the day you sign up.
items.flavor: Slow walkers. They stop to read every sign.

items.name: Sleep-On-It Nightcap

effects.text: Once per fight, a wrong answer becomes a miss with no damage taken.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 20 and deeper
items.lesson: A cooling-off rule turns 'I need it now' into 'do I still want it on Thursday?', and most of the time you don't.
items.flavor: Fluffy pom-pom. Infinite patience. Smells faintly of chamomile.

items.name: Cart Abandoner Cardigan

effects.text: 8% chance to dodge a boss attack.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 18 and deeper
items.lesson: Removing saved card details from shopping sites adds just enough friction to stop most impulse buys.
items.flavor: Seventeen items left in the cart. Zero regrets.

items.name: Wishlist Slacks

effects.text: Heal 3 HP after 3 correct answers in a row.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 5 and deeper
items.lesson: Putting a want on a wishlist instead of in the cart separates the wanting from the spending.
items.flavor: Deep pockets for wishes. No pockets for cards.

items.name: 24-Hour Slippers

effects.text: Gain a 2-HP shield after each correct answer.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 10 and deeper
items.lesson: Unsubscribing from store emails removes the 'sale ends tonight' pressure from your inbox.
items.flavor: You cannot sprint to checkout in slippers. That is the point.

items.name: Price-Check Cap

effects.text: 3% chance to dodge a boss attack.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: The unit price (cost per ounce, per load, per use) tells you which option is actually cheaper.
items.flavor: Has a tiny shelf-tag clipped to the brim.

items.name: Pay Stub Visor

effects.text: Gain a 2-HP shield after each correct answer.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: Gross pay minus taxes and deductions is net pay, and net pay is the number you can actually budget.
items.flavor: Printed with your gross pay. The fine print is your net pay.

items.name: Overdraft Opt-Out Helm

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 22% of your max HP.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 7 and deeper
items.lesson: You can opt out of overdraft coverage, so a card is declined instead of charging a $30-plus fee.
items.flavor: Says DECLINED across the front. Proudly.

items.name: Thrift Flip Hoodie

effects.text: Your first correct answer of each fight deals +8% damage.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: Buying used for things that lose value fast, like clothes, can cut the price in half or more.
items.flavor: Four dollars. Tags still on. Legendary energy, common rarity.

items.name: Paid-in-Full Plate

effects.text: Reflect 15% of damage taken back at the boss. When you owe nothing, interest works for you.
Damage can't vary: no crits and no glancing blows. Debt-free is steady, not flashy.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 26 and deeper
items.lesson: With no debt, every dollar of income is yours to save or invest instead of going to interest.
items.flavor: Stamped PAID across the chest. The bank's least favorite armor.

items.name: Side Hustle Joggers

effects.text: Dash recharges 15% faster.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 8 and deeper
items.lesson: A side hustle's real pay is what's left after costs and taxes; set aside around a quarter of it for taxes.
items.flavor: Built for running between two jobs and a group project.

items.name: Sinking Fund Cargo Pants

effects.text: Once per fight, a wrong answer becomes a miss with no damage taken. You saved for this one months ago.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 13 and deeper
items.lesson: A sinking fund saves a little each month for a known future cost (car repairs, gifts), so it never becomes an emergency.
items.flavor: Twelve pockets, each labeled with a month.

items.name: Thrift Store Kicks

effects.text: +2% damage per consecutive correct answer (up to 5 stacks).

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: The cheapest version of something is the one you already own or can borrow.
items.flavor: Previously owned by someone with excellent taste.

items.name: Index Fund Treads

effects.text: Start each fight with a 12-HP buffer.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 14 and deeper
items.lesson: A low-cost index fund owns hundreds of companies at once, so no single company can sink you.
items.flavor: Five hundred tiny treads. If one wears out, you barely notice.

items.name: Budget Pencil

effects.text: +2 seconds on hard questions.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: Writing a budget down, even on paper, makes you spend on purpose instead of by accident.
items.flavor: Eraser worn down to the metal. Every budget is a first draft.

items.name: Coupon Dagger

effects.text: Your first correct answer of each fight deals +10% damage.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: A coupon only saves money if you were going to buy the thing anyway.
items.flavor: Cuts along the dotted line. And through bosses.

items.name: Spare Change Wand

effects.text: Heal 3 HP after 3 correct answers in a row.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 2 and deeper
items.lesson: Rounding purchases up and saving the change turns tiny amounts into a real balance over a year.
items.flavor: Jingles when waved. Rounds every spell up to the nearest dollar.

items.name: Price-Match Spear

effects.text: 4% chance to dodge a boss attack.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 3 and deeper
items.lesson: Many stores will match a competitor's lower price if you ask, and asking is free.
items.flavor: Points at the cheaper price. Politely. Repeatedly.

items.name: Bargain Axe

effects.text: Take 3% less damage from every source.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 4 and deeper
items.lesson: Calling to negotiate bills like phone and internet once a year often gets the price cut; just ask what offers they have.
items.flavor: Chops prices. Mostly by asking nicely.

items.name: Rate Shopper's Bow

effects.text: Gain a 2-HP shield after each correct answer.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 6 and deeper
items.lesson: Comparing at least three offers for any loan, phone plan or insurance usually finds a noticeably better price.
items.flavor: Three arrows, three quotes, one winner.

items.name: Refinance Trident

effects.text: Start each fight with a 10-HP buffer. A lower rate frees up cash.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 8 and deeper
items.lesson: Refinancing replaces a loan with a cheaper one; a lower rate on a big balance can save thousands, after fees.
items.flavor: Three prongs: rate, fees, and term. Check all three.

items.name: Debt Snowball Hammer

effects.text: Dash recharges 15% faster. Quick wins keep you moving.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 12 and deeper
items.lesson: The snowball method pays off the smallest balance first; it costs a bit more than the avalanche but the quick wins keep people going.
items.flavor: Gets bigger every time it knocks something over.

items.name: Opportunity Cost Scythe

effects.text: Damage can't vary: no crits and no glancing blows. Choosing reliable damage means giving up crits.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 15 and deeper
items.lesson: Every choice costs the best thing you gave up to make it; that hidden price is the opportunity cost.
items.flavor: Reaps what you didn't choose. Very philosophical. Very sharp.

items.name: Compound Interest Greatsword

effects.text: Deal 10% more damage.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 23 and deeper
items.lesson: At about 10% a year, money roughly doubles every 7 years, and most of the final pile is interest earned on interest.
items.flavor: Forged one tiny layer at a time over a very long time. Mostly the second part.

items.name: Return Policy Shield

effects.text: Reflect 5% of damage taken back at the boss.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: Keep receipts and check the return window; a return turns a bad buy back into money.
items.flavor: 30-day guarantee. Store credit not accepted.

items.name: Spending Log

effects.text: Heal 2 HP after 3 correct answers in a row.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: Tracking every purchase for one month shows where your money really goes, which is rarely where you guessed.
items.flavor: Coffee, coffee, snack, coffee. Hmm.

items.name: Comparison Guidebook

effects.text: Once per fight, remove 1 wrong answer from a question.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: Reviews and price-history tools show whether a 'sale' price is actually a deal or just the normal price in a costume.
items.flavor: Dog-eared on every page. Highlighted in three colors.

items.name: Emergency Fund Lantern

effects.text: Start each fight with a 6-HP buffer.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 3 and deeper
items.lesson: One month of expenses saved is a great first goal; three to six months is the full emergency fund.
items.flavor: Never runs out of light. Just needs a refill now and then.

items.name: Cash Envelope Book

effects.text: Your first correct answer of each fight deals +12% damage.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 5 and deeper
items.lesson: With the envelope method, each spending category gets its own cash; when an envelope is empty, that category is done for the month.
items.flavor: Every page is an envelope. One says FUN. It is always empty first.

items.name: Deductible Shield

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 25% of your max HP.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 6 and deeper
items.lesson: A deductible is what you pay before insurance kicks in; a higher deductible means a cheaper premium but a bigger bill when something happens.
items.flavor: Absorbs everything above the first chunk. The first chunk is on you.

items.name: Credit Freeze Shield

effects.text: 6% chance to dodge a boss attack. Identity thieves bounce right off.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 9 and deeper
items.lesson: Freezing your credit is free and stops anyone from opening new accounts in your name; you can unfreeze it whenever you need.
items.flavor: Cold to the touch. Thieves hate it.

items.name: Savings Goal Lantern

effects.text: Gain a 3-HP shield after each correct answer.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 12 and deeper
items.lesson: Naming a goal and a date turns 'save more' into a monthly number you can actually hit.
items.flavor: Glows brighter the closer you get. Very motivating. Slightly smug.

items.name: High-Yield Shield

effects.text: +4% damage per consecutive correct answer (up to 5 stacks).

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 17 and deeper
items.lesson: High-yield savings accounts often pay several times more interest than a big bank's basic savings account, with the same safety.
items.flavor: Same shield, ten times the shine.

items.name: Net Worth Ledger

effects.text: +5 seconds on hard questions.
Dash recharges 15% faster.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 30 and deeper
items.lesson: Net worth is everything you own minus everything you owe; tracking it once a month shows if you are really moving forward.
items.flavor: Two columns. One number. The whole picture.

items.name: Late Fee Imp Horn

effects.text: +2 seconds on hard questions.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 1 and deeper
items.lesson: Most late fees are completely avoidable with autopay or a reminder set a few days before the due date.
items.flavor: Still faintly whispering "due yesterday".

items.name: Impulse Goblin's Receipt

effects.text: 3% chance to dodge a boss attack.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 2 and deeper
items.lesson: A 24-hour pause before non-essential buys stops most impulse spending.
items.flavor: Four feet long. Every item says FINAL SALE.

items.name: Overdraft Ooze Jar

effects.text: Start each fight with a 5-HP buffer.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 3 and deeper
items.lesson: Checking your balance before you spend, or keeping a small cushion in checking, keeps overdraft fees away.
items.flavor: Lid screwed on tight. It still drips sometimes.

items.name: Subscription Stinger

effects.text: Dash recharges 10% faster.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 4 and deeper
items.lesson: Audit your subscriptions every few months; $10 a month is $120 a year for something you may not use.
items.flavor: Auto-renews its sting. Cancel anytime.

items.name: FOMO Phantom Veil

effects.text: Once per fight, remove 1 wrong answer from a question. You had a plan before the hype.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 6 and deeper
items.lesson: Buying something because it already went up a lot is buying high; decide your plan before the hype shows up.
items.flavor: Whispers "everyone else is doing it". You have learned to ignore it.

items.name: Hidden Fee Gear

effects.text: Take 4% less damage from every source.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 7 and deeper
items.lesson: A 1% yearly fee sounds tiny, but over 30 years it can eat about a quarter of what an investment would have grown to.
items.flavor: One tooth is missing. It was charging a maintenance fee.

items.name: Lifestyle Creep Shell

effects.text: +3% damage per consecutive correct answer (up to 5 stacks).

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 9 and deeper
items.lesson: When your income goes up, raise your savings rate first and your spending second.
items.flavor: Was a small shell once. Kept upgrading.

items.name: Payday Leech Fang

effects.text: Reflect 10% of damage taken back at the boss. You bite back.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 12 and deeper
items.lesson: Payday loans can cost around 400% APR; even a small emergency fund keeps you from ever needing one.
items.flavor: Pulled out painlessly. Unlike the loan.

items.name: Minimum Payment Mask

effects.text: Heal 5 HP after 3 correct answers in a row.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 15 and deeper
items.lesson: Paying only $25 a month on a $1,000 card at 24% APR takes about 7 years and costs more in interest than the original $1,000.
items.flavor: Smiles no matter what you owe. Very suspicious.

items.name: Rug Pull Rat Tail

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 20% of your max HP. You never put in more than you could afford to lose.

items.unlock: dungeon: drops from floor 20 and deeper
items.lesson: Any investment that promises guaranteed huge returns is almost certainly a scam; real returns come with real risk.
items.flavor: The rat ran. The tail stayed. Guaranteed.
